messages:
Alex G: :rotating_light: Alert from monitoring — inference queue for gpu-pool 'spot-inference-usw2' spiked to ~12.3k pending requests. Pod pending count x 1.2k, preemptions reported ~42% in the last 10m. Error rate on /v1/generate is up to 18%. Logs show repeated preemption messages: \"Container terminated: Host reclaims GPU (preemptible)\".
Incident Bot: Incident created: GPU capacity exhaustion — spot preemption surge. Severity: P1. Pager routed to oncall-rotation.
Maria S: Ack, joining. Which autoscaler group is this hitting?
Zach L: This is the spot pool behind the autoscaler group 'gpu-spot-usw2-asg'. Autoscaler is at configured max (50 nodes). We have cloud quota for GPUs in region = 50, so ASG can't request more.
Alex G: Confirmed. Autoscaler reports: \"Desired=50, Current=50, Max=50, PendingPods=1200\". Also our fallback policy to 'dedicated-evictable' is failing — fallback pool is saturated and hitting per-tenant placement limits.
Maria S: Customer-facing impact: latency >5s for most requests; some timeouts. Not yet widespread 503 across all orgs but several high-volume customers seeing errors. I've notified CS to prepare an outbound.
Zach L: Quick mitigation options: 1) throttle low-priority routes (batch jobs, async); 2) switch routing for high-priority orgs to dedicated pool (non-spot) if capacity exists; 3) start manual node add to a different region; 4) ask infra to request emergency quota bump — but that takes time.
Alex G: Trying 1 and 2 now. Applying temporary rate-limit to 'batch-ingest' and 'async-embeddings' routes. Command: 
```
# curl to internal API to patch throttles
curl -X POST https://internal-console/api/routes/patch -d '{"route":"batch-ingest","concurrency":4}'
```
Alex G: Also toggled routing policy to prefer dedicated variants for the top 5 paying orgs: changed weight from 0.1 -> 0.9.
Incident Bot: oncall-rotation acknowledged the page (Alex G).
oncall-rotation: I'm oncall, joining. Any ETA for queue reduction after throttles?
Maria S: Early signal: queue dropped from 12.3k -> 8.6k after throttles and routing changes (5m). Error rate down from 18% -> 11% but still elevated.
SRE Lead: We need to address root cause: spot reclaim rate high across the region right now. Check cloud provider advisories for maintenance/availability. Also open ticket for quota increase.
Zach L: Filed cloud request (REQ-6732) for GPU quota increase to 80 in us-west-2. Also spinning up a temp dedicated pool in eu-west-1 as cross-region spillover. Plan: create 8 dedicated nodes (A100 equiv) and add to routing - takes ~12-15m.
Kevin P: I'll coordinate with infra to get dedicated nodes standing. Also recommend we reduce streaming windows / lower per-connection concurrency to free KV cache pressure.
Maria S: CS update: Sending preliminary status to impacted customers now — short note that we see degraded performance and are mitigating. No promise of ETA yet.
Alex G: Temporary script to move non-urgent jobs to cold queue: 
```
# move jobs older than 30s to cold queue
python tools/requeue.py --age 30 --target cold-queue
```
Alex G: Executed. That reduced pending pod pressure by ~200 pods.
Incident Bot: cloud-alert: provider reported increased spot reclamation signals in us-west-2 across instance family G. Link: https://cloud.status/notice/spot-reclaims-2026-03-15
SRE Lead: Good to know. Priority: 1) keep latency-sensitive customers routed to non-spot capacity; 2) throttle/repurpose all async/low-priority work; 3) request quota; 4) longer-term: tweak fallback policy to prefer ondemand when preemption % > 30%.
oncall-rotation: Dedicated nodes in eu-west-1 are coming up — monitoring config push in progress. Will add to model routing as a new pool 'dedicated-spill-eu'.
Maria S: Metric check 10m later: queue 8.6k -> 5.1k after eu nodes join and throttles. Error rate now ~6.5%. Customer complaints dropped.
Zach L: Note: some requests are latency-sensitive with regional affinity — moving them to eu will add RTT; we only moved top paying orgs who have consented or multi-region.
Alex G: We should also patch the autoscaler config: current max nodes=50 is too small. Propose temp patch to max=80 to allow more spot nodes if quota increases. I can open PR.
SRE Lead: Go ahead. Also create postmortem runbook entry for 'spotless fallback' case — we almost lacked a clean fallback because dedicated pools were sized conservatively.
Kevin P: I've created a handoff doc and started a runbook ticket: RUN-9823. Summary and mitigations applied: throttled low-priority routes; routing changes for top orgs; stood up eu dedicated spill; filed quota increase; moved jobs to cold queue; updated autoscaler max to 80 (pending PR).
Maria S: Handing to Kevin P for follow-up and RCAs. I'll stay on thread for customer comms.
SRE Lead: Handoff OK. Oncall (Kevin P) owns next 12h to ensure stability and chase quota and permanent capacity changes. If preemptions continue at >30% after quota, we'll shift permanent fallback to ondemand.
Kevin P: Acknowledged. I'll schedule a 1:1 with infra to prioritize permanent capacity and follow up on cloud request. Will post status every hour until resolved.
Alex G: Final note — collect sample request IDs for failed jobs and attach to postmortem. Example request IDs: req_8f3a, req_d21b, req_91fc.
Incident Bot: Incident marked as 'mitigated' at 2145682500. Owners: Kevin P (oncall follow-up), SRE Lead (RCA), Maria S (customer comms), Zach L (infra).
